title: Hatsune Miku — Card Story

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hello, everybody!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thanks for coming to the show!
I hope you'll all have fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And now... Let the music begin!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, are you watching Miku's show?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. There was a VIRTUAL SINGER event just the other day, and Miku was a part of it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They put up a snippet of the event for a limited time only.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! Can I watch the rest with you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is amazing...
It's as if Miku was actually performing right there on the stage!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You can't tell she's a 3D hologram at all!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. And if the video already makes us feel this way, going to the show in person must be even better.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
The cheers were deafening!
That's real nice. Everyone there must've enjoyed themselves.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're not done yet!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is my next song!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, I know this song too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And the dance routine is so cute!
Look at the way her clothes and hair are fluttering around...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of Miku, is her hair actually green or blue?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Why do you ask?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I sometimes see people discussing it on social media, and that got me thinking. It's true though. Which is it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And some people claim it's the color of spring onion, too. Why spring onion, though?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. The spring onion part, well...
I'll show you a video later.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? What for?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You'll understand the spring onion thing after that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, the color of Miku's hair changes depending on the person looking at her or drawing her.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What, really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And that difference is what makes her Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The color you think you see is the color Miku is to you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The color she is to me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Her hair looks green to me, personally...
Is it okay for me to say that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, maybe I might change my view if I actually saw her performing live, though?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Maybe.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I knew it! That sounds nice.
Maybe we should all go watch her together someday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We should.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks for coming today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you have fun?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Until we meet again next time, when I can bring you more songs!
Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Maybe I should remove this part.
And add more effects here...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (A video? It's from Yuki...)
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hello, everybody!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thanks for coming to the show!
I hope you'll all have fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And now... Let the music begin!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This is...a video of a Hatsune Miku event?)

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Yuki, what's this for?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Oh, sorry for sending you a message when you were muted. I just really wanted to share this video with you.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <That link just now goes to a VIRTUAL SINGER video...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <It's available online for a limited time only, right?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <That's the one! You already knew about it?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Yes. A lot of content creators are involved with the VIRTUAL SINGER. I can learn a lot from them.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I see. I've gotten a little interested lately and have started listening to all sorts of songs.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Especially the ones sung by Miku.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <What do you think of Miku, K?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <What do you mean?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Have you ever thought about letting Miku sing the songs that you've composed?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Yes, I've thought about that before.
It's still one of my options now, too.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <For example... Listen to this part here.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Around here.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <This upper register has the tendency to sound forced when sung by the human voice.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <And also...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <The lyrics are clear even though she's singing so quickly.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Yes.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<She has a massive vocal range and great tone.
Even her breathing sounds real.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <There's a lot of vocal expressions only Miku can achieve.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <But?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Well...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <If I do compose a song that's just right for Miku in that way, I would definitely let her sing it.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <A song that's just right for Miku...>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Okay. I can't wait to hear it!>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Yuki...>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Yes?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <What made you develop an interest in Miku?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Oh, it's nothing significant, really.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I just had this little encounter...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <With?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Well... Oh, I'm sorry. I interrupted your work, right? I'm going back to work now too, so please carry on.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Okay, I will...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Miku, huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for listening to my song, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I won't ever stop singing, so don't ever stop listening♪
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: How's it going today, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm? It's going great. Both my guitar and I are in top condition! Would you like to do a session together to see for yourself?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Sure. Shall we get started right away?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Saki! Ichika! Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We, um... We've got a favor to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The studio where we normally practice is temporarily closed for refurbishment...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We tried to find somewhere else we could play, but everywhere's fully booked.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would it be okay if we...practiced here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's what you came to ask?
Of course you can use this SEKAI as you please. It's yours.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: By the way, Miku and I were just about to have a musical session.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Would you like to join us?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We can play with you?!
But we're only rookies... Is that okay with you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We don't mind, and it will be more fun if we play together!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, Miku and Luka!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Let's get set up.
Luka, do you need a tuner?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, thanks.
I'll get my bass tuned.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Have you already checked your guitar, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You mean, checked if the strings haven't gone rusty or too loose? I always do that before playing. You taught me to do so.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So you normally get advice from Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. She's more experienced than me at playing in a band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I didn't know that.
But still, you're more experienced than me and Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So in a way, you're our seniors!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let me guess, the whole junior-senior dynamic is another school life feature you romanticize?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, was it that obvious?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, I don't mind becoming a mentor figure.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In that case, I'll have to act with more respect!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Miku and Luka, you do us a great honor allowing us two scrubs to play together with you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, now you say something polite!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... Thank you for this...unique opportunity?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, this makes me feel more important somehow!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We should also title you properly.
So it's Miss Hatsune and Miss Megurine!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, this feels very different.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But it also puts a distance between you and us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I guess so...
What would be better...? Oh, I know! Miss Miku!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And what about Luka?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um... Lady Luka!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why the different standards...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Teehee♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, you heard that, Luka? You're a lady.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That doesn't have a bad ring to it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... Or maybe Miss Miku and Ms. Luka would be better?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I'd like to just keep calling you by your first names, without any titles, as before.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If you don't mind?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. If that's what you're most comfortable with, then of course that's fine.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Precisely. If you want to title us for fun, that's fine, but we can just be informal.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You don't need to use formal titles to communicate a respectful attitude.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It seems we're all done tuning our instruments.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's play some music!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, hello?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Miku, are you here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I am! Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry to bother you, but is it okay if we borrow this space for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure. Is your usual studio still closed for refurbishment?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, that's not why we decided to come over here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We already had a rehearsal at the studio, but Shiho and I wanted to practice some more...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we wanted to work more on some bits.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well then, could I join you as lead guitar?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I play with Ichika and Saki sometimes, but I haven't had the chance to play with you two, yet.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
If you'd like to, then of course!
We'll happily play with you. Isn't that right, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have no objections.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay then! Let's begin!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miku!
It was really helpful to have you play with us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. It was a really good practice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're more than welcome!
It was very satisfying. I had a great time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, it's better when we all play together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, don't be rude...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry.
I guess that sounded ungrateful...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe, don't worry. I know what you meant.
Having the whole band together is the best.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that's exactly it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami, thanks for catching that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No problem! I'm glad I didn't upset you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: On a different note, there's this question that's been on my mind for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The first time we met here in SEKAI, you suggested that we all play together. Why?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I was wondering about that too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It's very simple.
I knew you'd understand each other through music.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You wanted us to communicate through music?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You seemed to have trouble communicating with words alone, so I thought that might work for you better.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You were right. Back then I found it very difficult to talk to Shiho and the others...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But playing together was an entirely different matter.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: To make it work, everyone has to listen carefully to one another. Pay attention to what the others are doing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, but we did play terribly.
The tempo was all over the place, and you guys kept missing notes...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But despite that, it left a lasting impression on me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Same for me. And also...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Even though we kept making mistakes...
I was very excited to be playing with you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Miku, you made it happen.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, Miku, thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, you're most welcome.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You guys were amazing today!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Just one more song!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's have fun on stage until the very end!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great singing, Miku and Rin! I brought you some towels.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, that's just what I needed! Thanks, Airi♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This one's for you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank YOU for checking out our performance!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It was our pleasure.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But wouldn't you have preferred it if we watched you sing and dance from the audience seats?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nope! It's useful to know how the performers sharing the stage look too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, I'm glad we could help!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let us know if there's anything else we can do for you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Don't be shy and show us every new performance!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You guys are great, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
By the way, Airi...
Wasn't there something you wanted to ask them?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Was there? Ah, that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You've got a question for us? Alright, shoot!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's a bit personal, I hope you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What's your selling point?
Like, what's your theme?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Our...selling point?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And theme?

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't think we've got anything in the sense you're asking. We do gigs together, but we're not an idol group.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Seriously?! How come you can sing and dance so well if you're not a tight-knit idol group driven by a shared vision?! Maybe it's down to you being VIRTUAL SINGERS...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But if you did settle on a theme, and got a producer to market you, you could become a phenomenon out of this world!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Miku could go for the pure and innocent girl theme.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Rin, you have the makings of a top younger sister type idol... Together, you could amplify each other's appeal!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um... What do you want us to do, exactly?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, Airi's totally obsessed with all things related to idol groups.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The original idol duo who made it big were PINKY WINK. They went with the cool and mysterious vibes that were popular back then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Recently, there are only few duos.
Most idols either work solo, or as part of big groups.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I think you have huge potential as a duo of two idols with different themes! Sometimes you pull in different directions, but it highlights each other's best points...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're smiling to yourself, Miku. What are you thinking?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: About this SEKAI, how it's created from the energy of lots and lots of shows.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's filled with the happy emotions fans feel when watching their idols performing on stage.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It made me itch to do more shows too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, same here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's keep doing them together then!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But in the end we didn't decide on themes for you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's the one downside of having ridiculously huge potential. It makes it harder to narrow down which way of producing you as idols would be best.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, you tried, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks for putting so much thought into it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oooh!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What's the matter, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Since our role is to help people discover their true feelings...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Couldn't we be helper idols?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Helpers, huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How about angelic idols helping out those in need?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then you can incorporate the pure and innocent, and younger sister themes into that! But why stop there...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, she's on a roll now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. It seems we're going to learn a lot about idols today♪
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Rin, have you put your costume on yet?
The show's starting soon!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm almost done, just have to tie my ribbon!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How are you, Miku and Rin?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Do you have a moment?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure, what do you need?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We wanted to ask you if we could watch your show too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course you can!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is it just the two of you today?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. We came because Airi and Shizuku kept boasting about the shows they've seen here without us, saying they were exceptional.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe, that's nice to hear!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'll have to treat you to an exceptional show too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why don't you go sit in the front row for the best view? We'll see you in a bit!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, front row seats! I've got really bad luck with getting the seats I want, so I rarely ever get to watch a show this up close!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm happy you get front row seats today, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you for your patience! Here we are!
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yaaay! Miku! Rin!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you for the lovely applause♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Today we're joined by two special guests! Minori and Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Minori, thank you so much for your very spirited cheering!
Muah♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Oooh! Miku blew me a kiss?!
Did this really happen?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You said you wanted to pick up some tricks of the trade from them, but you're just letting yourself get swept away...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It was amazing to have that encouragement from you, and we're now ready to perform our first number! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That was wonderful, thank you.
Minori, don't you want to say anything?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uh... Thank...you so much...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm? Is something the matter, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It looks like the special attention you gave her was too effective. She'll recover in time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Ugh... My heart's still racing!
I can't believe Miku blew me a kiss from the stage!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I wonder what it'd be like if Haruka did that for me one day...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nnngh!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I-I'm fine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Just imagining it nearly gave me a heart attack!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your face is all red...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's n-nothing! Anyway, I wanted to say that you were totally awesome! I was on the edge of my seat watching you dance and listening to your singing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, you liked it that much?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you know what's more amazing than us here? The power of your feelings!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's your feelings that created this whole world.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So the reason we can stage shows here and bring fun to everyone is you guys!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's right! And if your feelings could lead to that, you have what it takes to make even more people happy with your own shows!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aw, Miku... Rin... Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Look forward to seeing what we can achieve!
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm, my voice seems to carry farther than usual today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I heard singing coming from this street... There she is!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hello, girls.
What can I do for you today?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well, we didn't come here for any special reason...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Other than we missed you!
Sorry if we interrupted your singing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You didn't interrupt me, don't worry about it. I'm happy to see you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's nice!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you often sing here on this street?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I do, actually. It has good acoustics, and I just like it here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I totally get you.
We usually sing on Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There's more space there, but that also means I have to sing really loud or my voice gets drowned out by the noise.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it's good practice for gigs, and it helps me project my voice better.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... I'd like to hear the results of that practice!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You want me to sing for you right now?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why not? Let's do this, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Won't it be cool to do a mini performance here, in Miku's favorite spot?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I... I suppose so!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um, Miku...
I'll give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Great! What will you sing for me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Maybe...
The song which led to me to become An's partner?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Great choice! Let's sing it then!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew... So w-was it okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It was great!
I loved how you two were really enjoying yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You were so into it. That's your song, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! It's our special number!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Do you have any songs like that, Miku?
That have a special meaning to you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... Something that would bring back memories...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The song that comes to mind is the one born from your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... And you were even singing it earlier when we arrived.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This SEKAI and the versions of me and my friends who live in it have been created by your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's why the song embodying them is very special to us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just like it has that special meaning to you, it also has unique significance to us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, hearing that makes me kind of overwhelmed by how much influence our feelings have on everything!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's so strange to think that a world could be created from feelings.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it's like a fantasy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's not so easy to kindle feelings which can do that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your feelings need to be really powerful to make a SEKAI appear. It's very rare for it to happen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It can be compared to your singing. You've had to practice many times to sing that song well, to perfect it. It took you a lot of time and effort.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You became able to sing it well because of your strong desire to sing better.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's like this with SEKAI, too. They grow over time with very strong feelings, nourished by unwavering determination.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I get it now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This whole world is here because we've all been working together towards surpassing RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's really something...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But if our passion for singing grows stronger, will that give birth to yet another SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Who knows?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You can't tell us? That's going to keep bugging me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I guess we'll just have to test it out for ourselves!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Good luck, girls.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome! Oh, it's you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Welcome, Akito.
I see you've got Toya in tow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are Kohane and An not with you this time?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why do you expect us to turn up together anyway?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because the four of you are a team, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It just means we have the option to sing together. Besides, having the same goals doesn't mean we always hang out together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your partner is as prickly as ever, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That shows he's in good mood.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Well, I'm not complaining.
I'm happy to get to see you in my cafe, with or without your other guys.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sit down and relax.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Pick any table you like, the place is all yours.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure thing. Toya, you want a coffee too?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Two coffees then? I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you looking for something, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just wondering why Len's not here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: He might come later, but he doesn't come here every day.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You wanted to talk to him?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It wasn't anything important...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He wanted to make sure Len patched things up with his partner.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh? I see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He's helped me a great deal, so I wanted to check up on him.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You have a strong sense of duty, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He does. He turns up for work half an hour before his shift to check the inventory and whatnot, even though he only needs to be there ten minutes early.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're short-staffed, so I gotta do that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is that so?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't think that's the real reason.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Are my words worth nothing to you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Despite appearances, you have a serious nature?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not serious, but responsible, I'd say.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If he says he'll do something, he will without cutting any corners. He's a perfectionist, and not only when it comes to music, but also his job and soccer club.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even more so when the other people involved are also very dedicated.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmph...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why don't you talk about this kind of stuff when I'm not here, huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: He just wanted to clear up any misconceptions about you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's right. Akito's easily misunderstood, which was the case with Kohane. It makes life harder for me too, so I rather it didn't happen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You hear that, Akito?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your coffees are ready!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You seem perplexed.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's just that Toya's never been the chatty type but today he won't keep his mouth shut. Maybe he and Miku are on the same wavelength?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Since this SEKAI has been created from your feelings, and we're part of it, our personalities are somewhat similar to yours.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is that so...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Another example, Akito's very caring towards his sister. He goes out to buy her snacks whenever she asks him to—

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Enough, Toya! I don't want you gossiping about me!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
And what's the situation with Len?
Did he make up with his partner?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Won't it be better if you ask him yourself?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It doesn't look like he's coming today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then ask him next time you see him.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll have to come again, and I wanted to get it done today.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You should visit whenever you like. It's your SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Let's try again some other time, Akito.
We'll run into him eventually.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sigh... Fine.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: See you next time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The coffee was delicious, thank you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're welcome. Take care, guys!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: See you.
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is such a marvelous place.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The flowers sing, a steam train flies above, it's all like a giant stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Is something amiss, Tsukasa?
You don't seem too pleased.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When I asked you for inspiration for our next show on the rooftop a moment ago...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I didn't mean THIS! What did you drag me here for again?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh. Are you not excited to be here?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Have I ever been excited about this place?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Every time we come here, we end up as Miku's pawns. I don't want to discuss our shows here, I want to get out before we get caught up in some silliness again!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see... In that case we should go and find Miku at once.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What, why?! Did you not hear what I said?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I did, and it seems to me that getting caught up in some silliness is precisely what we need.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's an excellent way to find inspiration.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Besides, isn't Miku like Emu in some ways?
Meeting her is sure to inject you with positive energy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Positive energy? If anything, she DRAINS me of energy with all the incongruous stuff she says!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Haha, well, that's unfortunate.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Very unfortunate, yes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's no concern to you, is it, Rui?
Why is it always me suffering because of Emu's or Miku's antics...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hold on...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Aaargh! She's already here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Eek!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-You sneaked up on me!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, I didn't! I saw you from over there and you seemed to be having fun, so I ran right over!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's been a long time since I last saw you! How have you been?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Very well, thank you.
As for Tsukasa, you can see for yourself.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: M-My heart's going to give out if you keep this up...
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's good to see you two are well! Is there any specific reason you came here today, or did you just want to hang out?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I wouldn't come here just to hang out!
We're here on a quest for inspiration.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Inspiration for...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our next show. Maybe you could tell us what sort of performances you normally do, and we could use that as a starting point?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm, what could I describe as our usual repertoire... The other day we did magic tricks in our show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, that's a good one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It was a huge hit!
KAITO climbed into a box and I stabbed it with swords!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I had five swords, and was supposed to only use three, but I decided to just use all of them! That made KAITO panic for a moment there!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
He's really good at acting!
His screams were SO REAL! I was very impressed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, that must have been a very thrilling show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-Is KAITO okay?! He's not...you know...is he?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, he's perfectly fine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Th-Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We've also done a show about heroes defeating villains, and one with flying!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Our concept for the next one is swimming with dolphins. I've already got KAITO working on it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heroes, flying, swimming...
That's totally random.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Miku. It was very informative.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your shows can be summed up in one word. Unconventional.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We have much to learn from you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Er... I think we could've done without Miku's wisdom.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But maybe you did point us in the right direction. We should let our imagination spread its wings without worrying about conventions.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe! So I helped?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You did!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You can always come and watch our shows, you know! You're welcome anytime♪
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yaaay!
You came to see me? That's so great!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Miku! Hiii!
Let's have a playdate!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu, we're not toddlers. It's not a playdate, it's a girls' day out. I mean, maybe that's just what playdates for grown-ups are called...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do you do on a girls' day out?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We meet up and eat lots of candy, and talk lots too, and it's sooo much fun! Here, I brought a goodie bag of snacks and sweets♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've got cookies, chocolates, marshmallows, rice crackers...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, that's a banquet☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I didn't think it'd be possible to bring food over from the real world...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Why not? We carry over our stuff like smartphones, so why wouldn't it work with food?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I suppose that checks out...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But still, it somehow doesn't make sense in my head. This strange frustration must be what Tsukasa feels whenever he is talking to Emu...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm? Your eyebrows are getting all knotted, Nene! It looks funny.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Shall we go sit on the grass over there?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! You've got so many flowers around, and they all can talk!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I can't decide whether that's cool or creepy...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Do you think the flowers would like to be fed some snacks too?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Please, no, don't do that. That'd be too disturbing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sooo, what would you like to chat to me about?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm... I know!
Why don't you tell us how you normally spend time here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Come to think of it, what do I do...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Um, forget about me!
How do you spend your days, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh?
You want to know about me...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We go to different schools, so I also have no idea what you do most of the time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, what's your usual day like?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, tell us, tell us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But...why do we have to talk about me?
You were going to tell us about yourself, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Come on, Nene, don't make us beg you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, come on!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I understand Tsukasa better now... I wish I knew how to assert myself like he does...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene! Don't keep us waiting!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Tell us about yourself!
Curiosity's driving me crazy now!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tell us～♪ Tell us～♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Why...?
Why are you singing at me?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want to know too♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Flowers, sing with us!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Emu
rows.Line: I～♪ want～♪ to～♪ know～♪

rows.Speaker: Miku & Emu
rows.Line: Lalala～～～～♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Fine! Fine!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'll answer your question, so please stop singing!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I never imagined I'd miss Tsukasa so much...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So? How do you spend your days?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I don't get up to anything too exciting.
It's quite boring, really....

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let us be the judges!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Besides, we're not here for spicy gossip.
We just want to get to know you better!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! You can tell us just about anything, there's no pressure!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But when I'm done, it'll be your turn, okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sure♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Line: I should get going.

rows.Line: (I'm bored.)

rows.Line: Hehe, you think so? She's our dear group member, after all.

rows.Line: So what if I am! Get off my back!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ena... Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Please look after Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Um, sure.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Since you're asking, I'll make an effort.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, bye for now. We'll see you again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Bye, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay... Bye.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And...thank you.
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Mafuyu's been sitting there since coming to SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She says she wants to be left alone.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But why does she want to be left alone?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She needs everyone... I'm sure of it.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What are you doing?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I sat down.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why did you sit down behind me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I thought it would be better than sitting in front of you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sitting down like that is going to be distracting no matter where you sit. If you want to sit with me, sit beside me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hey...
What do you actually want me to do?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want you to find your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want to...sing the song born from them together with you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Song...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes... When I heard K's songs, I thought I might be able to find myself through them...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What if...I made more songs as well?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But... If that doesn't help me find myself, then I...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It's been a few days since we had that conversation.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Mafuyu is intensely focused on writing new songs by herself whenever she comes to SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know...who I really am.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Where can I find...my feelings?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She's in so much pain.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (No matter how many songs she makes...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's done...
But I...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Do what you want.
I have to make another song...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (This song...is not the one either.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She needs everyone, just like I thought.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (In order for her to find her true feelings...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have to go find them.
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now that Miku's heard our new song, we should be heading back soon.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. It's late and I'm getting sleepy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you slept in until this evening, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why does it matter? I can't help when I feel sleepy!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you. Come again soon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm staying behind.
I want to talk to Miku about something.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, got it.
Ena and I will head back first, then. What about you, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll stay for a bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh... Okay. That may be for the best.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Good night, everyone.
See you later!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Good night.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Bye...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe... Looks like they're trying to be mindful of me. It's fine. I won't be shutting myself in SEKAI anymore.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What did you want to talk to Miku about?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I wanted to ask her something.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Miku... How long will we be able to come here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How long?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You said you wanted to sing the song born from my true feelings together.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And you've achieved that objective, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wouldn't this SEKAI disappear then?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It won't.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How come?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This SEKAI and that song are proof that you were able to face yourself despite your worries and anguish.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
So this SEKAI will keep existing.
The song you found with Kanade, Ena, and Mizuki will keep existing as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even if you should forget about this SEKAI one day, it will never disappear.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is an important place that was born from your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A world like this with nothing at all...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There is something here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Looks like there's no need for you to be worried, then.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You were worried that this place might disappear one day, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I...think so.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you sure? You won't ever disappear?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Even if...I disappear?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
This is the world of your feelings.
It will always be here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay then...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe.
How cute.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Miku?
What do you look so happy for?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, Rin! Look at this!
Ta-da!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: These are the new costumes for our next show♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! They're so cute!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's going to look perfect on you!
Try it on!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Not yet.
We agreed to practice right up until the next show first, remember?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, come on! I just want a quick peek...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hello!
Miku, Rin, are you here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori!
Hello!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, there!
Are you alone today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yeah.
I thought I'd come do some practicing on my own.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Really?! We were just talking about our next show.
Since you're here, would you like to practice with us?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Of course!
Let's practice!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehehe.
Thanks for the invite, Miku! Rin!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One, two, three, four, turn!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Minori, you're really making sure to do each and every step carefully, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah. I'm still kind of a beginner at this idol stuff.
My dancing isn't very good unless I really focus like this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't think that's true! You've really improved!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-You think so?
Hehe, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm still going to work even harder, though!
One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Minori sure is working hard.
She's really improving.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. It's too bad she doesn't really have the chance to see just how much she's improved, though.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, I have an idea!
What do you say we...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That's perfect!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Great! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks for practicing with me today.
I'll have to come back again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hey, Minori.
Do you think you can come back at the same time tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Sure. I don't have any plans after practice, so that should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Great! See you tomorrow, then! We'll be waiting!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay.
See you tomorrow!
The next day

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Miku, Rin, are you here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hi, Minori! We've been waiting for you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wah! So cute!
Is that a new costume?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yep!
We're unveiling them in our upcoming show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's great.
I'll make sure I'm here to cheer you on.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Minori, you should be in the show with us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?! I-I couldn't!
My dancing still needs a lot of work!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You'll be just fine, Minori!
You've gotten really good!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You haven't had nearly as many opportunities to perform in front of people like Haruka and the others, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, we want to help give you more chances!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Being an idol isn't about being able to perform a perfect song and dance routine.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The reason I get up on stage is so I can give joy and hope to others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You feel the same way, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I do!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I want to see everyone's smiling faces!
That's the reason I want to perform!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good! That's exactly how it should be!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: C'mon, Minori! Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Minori
rows.Line: Right!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The show we did the other day with Minori went great, don't you think?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It looked like she was really enjoying herself, too! It was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, it sure was! The whole crowd loved it, too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I hope our next show will be just as good.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, me too. What do you say we start thinking about what to do for next time?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sure!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We already make sure to always go all out on our singing and dancing, though.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know! How about we try adding some kind of fun segment in the middle of the show?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
An interesting segment?
But whoever's MCing already does that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What about doing a magic trick or something?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Didn't we already do one of those while singing that one time?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We've done so many shows that it's getting hard to come up with brand new ideas.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, this is tough...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hello, Miku, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hello!
What brings you here today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Actually, I wanted to stop by and say thanks again for asking me to perform with you the other day. It was really fun.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Don't mention it.
Having you up on stage with us was a lot of fun for us too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I hope you'll perform with us again some time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehehe, I'm happy to hear that!
I'm looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll make sure to practice extra hard so I'm ready whenever the time comes. More, more!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll have to work extra hard too, then!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin, now we really need to come up with a new way to get the audience extra fired up!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A new performance?
I guess you've always got to be thinking about what to do next, huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I still really liked the performance you did for us the first time we all came to this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I kind of wish I could see it again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You really want to see it even though you've already seen it before?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sure. You were so dazzling that night! It was wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry! I really need to get going!
I have to meet Haruka and the others for practice soon.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: See you later!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, right... Bye!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: See you soon, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh... Maybe we don't have to force ourselves to come up with new ideas all the time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah. We've got plenty of new outfits.
Maybe we've been overthinking this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Up until now, we've always tried our best to give the audience the best show that we can.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe instead of coming up with something new this time, we work on perfecting our previous performances?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I like that idea! It might be fun to mix and match ideas from different shows we've done, too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! This is going to be great!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I can't believe we've never thought about this before.
I feel like Minori just helped us grow as idols again.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, Rin! Let's get to planning!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Next, put this string over this finger...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Done.

rows.Line: There she is. Hello, Miku. We're here to visit.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, are you playing cat's cradle?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mizuki, you taught her how to play, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow... Is that a Jacob's ladder?
That's an advanced move for cat's cradle. You must've been practicing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I have a lot of time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I see! Well, I'm just glad that you're having fun with it♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What's the matter?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu's not here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ah... Mafuyu couldn't make it today because she has cram school. It's just us today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh. That's good to know.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, Mafuyu told us something new has appeared in this SEKAI. Can you show us what it is?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Something new...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think...it was a marionette?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You mean, this?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh wow, it's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It really is something new...
We've never seen this here before, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! If we had, I would definitely have noticed it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This marionette has always been in this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How so?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So...it's not something new that showed up because Mafuyu went to a doll exhibition and was influenced by it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu was ignoring it, but this marionette has always been in this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which means...this puppet became visible when Mafuyu decided to notice it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe. Something must have changed inside Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Changed, huh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait. Does that mean it's possible there's actually a lot of other things here right now, just that we can't see them?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...then we may be able to find some clues about how to create a song that will save Mafuyu here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't think you can...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why not?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's possible that only Mafuyu...the owner of this SEKAI's feelings, can find anything that's been hidden here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just like how nobody was able to find this marionette... Not even Mafuyu herself.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh..

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So basically, it's not going to be easy for us to find something even Mafuyu herself can't see, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um, so coming here wouldn't help at all, then?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No. It does help.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've already helped Mafuyu to make big changes.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Remember... This place used to be a Empty SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
She never used to let anybody into this SEKAI.
But now...you're all here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You all have a place in Mafuyu's heart.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We have a place in...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe, you have no idea how happy I am to hear that!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It doesn't feel that way to me at all, though.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe it's just that Mafuyu hasn't noticed it herself, yet?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So please keep looking for Mafuyu together with her, now and in the future.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You have my word. I'll definitely save her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! We'll fill this SEKAI up with all sorts of different things, like this marionette!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Eh, I wouldn't mind a less pesky version of her, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Again, Enanan? Just be honest with yourself already!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa! It's already 25:00!
Mafuyu should be back by now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, she's probably waiting for us.
We should head back.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just one last thing...this is a marionette puppet, right? Why doesn't it have strings?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm using its strings to play cat's cradle.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... Hehe. Of course.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hello, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you by yourself today?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I wanted to pass time before 25:00.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay.
Do you want to play cat's cradle together?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Not interested.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh. That's too bad. It's fun.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Do you mind if I sing?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You mind?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, I don't mind at all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It's the first time Mafuyu has ever asked to sing...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (These feelings...what are they?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Uneasiness, happiness, and sadness...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Are these Mafuyu's feelings?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Haa...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've never heard that song before.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, we made it just recently.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, okay. With what feelings?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Feelings...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I just turned the feelings of disgust I felt when I saw the marionette into lyrics, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then Kanade composed a song for it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kanade found you again, then.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She turned the feelings you weren't aware of into a song for you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I guess...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I wouldn't have thought about writing the lyrics myself if she hadn't asked me to.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Doesn't that just make it so that I'm only doing what Kanade's telling me to, this time?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That means the lyrics I wrote...they don't represent my true feelings?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't think so.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She may have given you the idea.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But those feelings you put into the lyrics that you wrote were definitely your own.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My own...feelings.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That...would be nice.
That would be really nice.
A few days after the Sports Festival
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay☆ I'm going to cheer you on with all I've got♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Go, KAITO! You can do it!
Keep it up! KAITOOO!

rows.Line: Thank you, Miku. You even got the plushies motivated and we had a great practice session.

rows.Line: Miku, Miku!

rows.Line:
Oh, it's the plushies!

rows.Line: We really liked your cheering!

rows.Line:
Yeah! It got me so energized!
Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm happy I could help! But the cheering can do much more than just that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What I saw at Emu's Sports Festival was literally out of this world!
