rows.Line: It was. And that's why Miku is so into cheering now.

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: What's a Sports Festival...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's umm... A school event with lots of people and...! Students are divided into teams that compete against each other!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Competing? That sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's one where you throw things into a basket, and one where you have to run and jump up and grab a piece of bread with your mouth!

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Sports Festival... That sounds exciting!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Do you want to have a Sports Festival here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You can all join and I'll be cheering for you! It's going to be great♪

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Let's have a Sports Festival!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is that okay, KAITO? We can do it, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course! You don't need to ask!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay♪ We have a lot to prepare then too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Indeed. First, we need to get the word out to all the plushies.

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: I can do that!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, there's someone I have to invite too!
I better do it right away!

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Who's Miku going to invite?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I think I can guess...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh no, I can't see anything!
Maybe Emu put her phone in her bag?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Alright, guys! Time for a break!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That's Tsukasa! He sounded far away but Emu has good ears, so she might be able to hear me...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hey! Emuuu!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, I hear footsteps! Emuuu!>

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Just a second. I'll take my phone out now!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Pwah! Thanks, Emu!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're welcome! Do you want to see the others? We were just taking a break.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<No, it's fine.
I don't want to disturb them.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, silly me! That means you're on break too, Emu...>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Don't worry about it! I'm not even tired or anything! Did you want to hang out together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Right! Actually, I dropped in to tell you something♪>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tell me something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Are you ready for it? We're going to have a Sports Festival in SEKAI!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! That's super duper wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I knew you'd think so! We're doing it for the plushies. They didn't know about them so...!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whaaat?! The Sports Festival is so amazing!
They've really been missing out...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes! My thoughts precisely!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So we're going to have our very own Sports Festival, it's going to be tons of fun for the plushies and it'll be great because I'll get to cheer for everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! They're not exactly the same, but Sports Festivals are a bit like shows too♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, Miku. Is it okay for us to come to your Sports Festival?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Of course! I'm actually here to invite you♪>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay, thanks! I'll let everyone else know!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Great! There's a lot of work to do, so I should go back now!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We want to make it as awesome as your school's Sports Festival!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Stay tuned!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I will!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Ahem! Hello, everyone!
Welcome and thank you for coming☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's time to kick off the Miku-tastic Wonder Sports Festival♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now I'd like to pass things over to KAITO♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you and hello, everyone. I'll be your MC for today's show!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Our lovely plushies have been divided into two teams, Team Red and Team White.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Tsukasa and company will even be joining them as support members...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Tsukasa and Emu, you'll be on Team Red.
Rui and Nene, you'll be on Team White.

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks for having us☆

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Welcome! Victory will be ours!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll try our best.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As for me, I'll be cheering you all on with my flower friends♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Singing Flowers
rows.Line: Go, Team Red! You can do it! Team White! Stand and fight!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa! I'm getting pretty pumped up!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Indeed! Now, our first event will be...
The scavenger race!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The lists are scattered around the plaza, so please pick whichever you like!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you're having trouble finding what you need, try looking for a treasure chest! You may just get lucky♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Treasure chests...? Interesting.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now, on your marks...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Get set... GO!

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Scamper... Scamper...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Flap... Flap...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Tanuki and Birdie are both off to a good start!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah☆ Woohoo! Go, go, go!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Hehehe☆ I've gotta run after them and keep cheering them on!)
Team Red

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (There! I found Team Red!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! We have our list!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We have to get a... Merry-go-round?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! But it's up in the sky!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hold on! These events usually have you look for glasses or something small like that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Hahaha! I knew they'd be shocked!)

rows.Speaker: Miku & Singing Flowers
rows.Line: You can do it, Team Red! Go, go!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, we've got Miku and the flowers rooting for us! How about we try and ride the merry-go-round?

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Yay! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hang on, why are you...?! Hey, wait up!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I wonder when they're going to notice the treasure chests. Hehehe, this is so much fun♪)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Okay, time to go and cheer the other team!)
Team White

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm stumped... It says Steam Train...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: It's so high up in the sky... Maybe this one's impossible...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, this is quite the conundrum.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Perhaps we should look for a treasure chest instead, as Miku suggested.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (That's Rui for you! He's a quick learner!)

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Hey, I found one already! Look!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What's inside...? Ah, it's a toy Ferris wheel.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe there's a toy steam train in one of the other treasure chests?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Hehe! Nene's team got it figured out!)

rows.Speaker: Miku & Singing Flowers
rows.Line: Go, go, Team White!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The winners of the scavenger hunt are... Team White!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, you did it♪ Go Team White!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Dang...! How were we supposed to guess that those toys were hidden in the treasure chests?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No matter! We just have to win the next one!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's get the next one, Tanuki!

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Here we go! Both teams are getting fired up!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Our next event will be the...
SEKAI Stamp Rally!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Each attraction has its own stamp, but each team must get them in order!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene, & Rui
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I'll be right behind you with some Miku-tastic encouragement!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, but Miku...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are you sure you only want to be cheering? Everyone else is having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Today, I just want to see them all smile♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe, I see.
Then you'll just have to cheer your heart out!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Come on, flowers! Let's go♪
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It's almost Christmas♪
What's our show gonna be like?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, how about one with lots of Santas!
Having lots of presents would be so much fun☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And what else... Oh? It's the plushies.

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line:
Did you hear?
KAITO's planning a Christmas show!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line:
What, really?
What's it going to be like?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Yay! It seems everyone's looking forward to Christmas!)

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Apparently this thing called snow is supposed to fall during Christmas too.

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line:
It's white, fluffy and falls from the sky!
It even disappears when you touch it!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: That's so strange, but it must be pretty! I'd like to see it!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: And, and, there's something called a sleigh that you can ride on and fly around the sky!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Wow! Will that be in the show too?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Snow and a flying sleigh...
Hehehe. These are some good ideas!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Hmm, I wonder if the plushies know about Santa too? And the reindeer? He's the one that rides the sleigh while delivering everyone's presents after all...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line: Miku! Come over and let's start talking about our next show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure♪ I'll be right there!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: First, does anyone already have any ideas for what they'd like to have in our Christmas show?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes! Me! Me! Me!
I want to have snow falling on the stage!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Snow on the stage...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And reindeer too!
With a sleigh that flies around the sky♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wow, reindeer and a flying sleigh?!
That all of that sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, those are some great ideas. And of course, it wouldn't be Christmas without Santa.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now let's think about how we can make it all happen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! We can do it! I know it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha, you're burning with motivation!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The plushies will love it!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One more thing! Let's invite the Wonderlands troupe♪ They might be able to give us some exciting ideas for our show too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do it together with them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay! I'll go over to Phoenix Wonderland to see Emu and the others!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sob... I'm back...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are you okay, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's wrong? Were you able to talk to them?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, I did but...
They're all busy preparing for their own show.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nene looked so sad too and said she wasn't interested in joining our show.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So they won't perform with us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, I'm not giving up just yet...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know what's eating away at Nene, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Tsukasa seemed determined to help her!
And I'm sure he will!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see.
In that case we can invite them again later.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (We'd still need someone to help with our show, though... But I know who else I might be able to recruit as actors.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Worst case scenario, we can at least invite them to watch our play.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! And the plushies have to see the show too! They'll get so excited about the snow and the flying sleigh!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yup! Um, wait a minute...
How did you know about the plushies?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We were talking about the show while you went over to Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It was easy to guess why you suggested snow and the sleigh since the plushies were talking about them too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe, was it that obvious?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We're going to have our hands full preparing this show. Let's all do our best!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay! Let's make it the best Christmas show ever and bring Christmas cheer to everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
La-di-da-di-da♪
As usual, we had a really fun performance!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Yeah! It was great! Let's finish putting the props away so we can go talk about it with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Okay! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, is someone waiting outside?
Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's Nene. Why's she not coming in?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Oh, maybe it's because she still feels shy around the plushies?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Well, let's make her more comfortable☆)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Little ones, you go and play.
I'll take care of the rest♪

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup! No problem!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nene! It's just me here now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh! Um...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
How are you, Nene?
Is there something you want to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I just wanted to tell you that we finished the last of our Christmas show performances and that they all went well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's great! And thank you for coming over to tell me about it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And what about the contest?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We managed to beat our rivals this round.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But they still lead in total points, so we have to do really well during our next performance to win.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's great! I'll be cheering for you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The first time you visited SEKAI, you spent the whole time hiding behind Robo-Nene...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But now you're here talking to me face to face☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe! It makes me very happy♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? What's wrong, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
There's no rush!
You can tell me whenever you like.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, well...
I've been wondering about this for some time...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This world was created based on Tsukasa's feelings, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You and KAITO have been inviting us here to see your shows, so that Tsukasa would remember what his true feelings were, I guess...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup, that's correct.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So this is what I don't get...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tsukasa's already discovered his true feelings, and I'm just performing in the same troupe as him so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why do you and KAITO care about me at all?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, that's simple! It's because we want to see you blossom as an actress!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh... That's it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But you do so much for me and encourage me every time I visit...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's not that I'm worried about Tsukasa getting annoyed with me getting so much support from you, but I feel like you're spoiling me with this being his SEKAI and all...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're absolutely not, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And besides, you have a connection to SEKAI too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa's wish of bringing joy to everyone with your shows is also your wish!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa also needs you, Emu and Rui to create the shows he dreams about!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You can't make great shows alone after all!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't you think so too, Nene? Don't you need your friends to create really special performances?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, I do...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Keep coming to SEKAI whenever you like!
I want to talk to you more and more♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Come for rehearsals, shows or just to hang out! You're always welcome here and promise not to be a stranger!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I promise...
Thanks, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Next time, I'll drop by just for fun.
I'll bring Emu along too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That'll be great☆
I'll be looking forward to it♪
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The Hanetsuki battle was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! The match between you and MEIKO versus Rin and Len at the end was so exciting!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Both pairs were like well-oiled machines and every rally lasted really long.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I like how you guys split into the front and back players. It felt very strategic with everyone calling out plays.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I noticed that too...
Have you guys played Hanetsuki before?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nope. It was our first time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I suppose we approached it like a badminton or tennis match. What do you think, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd say so.
It translated into Hanetsuki rather well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I see! But if you two were competing against each other, I wonder who'd win.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm curious about that too.
Why don't you two play against each other?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's alright.
I've had my fill of excitement.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Same here. Besides, I'd rather not have my face get all covered in ink...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Aww! You're no fun...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I guess we can get rid of the remaining ink then?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. We don't really have any use for it so...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... I don't think that's true.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Didn't you mention something about calligraphy and writing out what you want to do this year?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you mean New Year's resolutions?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Resolutions?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You think of what you want to achieve during the new year and write it with a calligraphy brush on a piece of paper.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
But calligraphy sounds kinda tough.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. But it'd be something new for us to try!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kohane, could you show us how it's done?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh, me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd like to see an example before I try it myself.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes. Please show us, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay. I'm not very good at calligraphy, but I'll give it my best shot!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you're doing it, so am I!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And how about you two?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll pass.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Same. We wouldn't have enough ink for everyone anyway.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, alright. Now, let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! MEIKO, can we use this table?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sure, but put this paper underneath so the wood doesn't get stained.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We'll do that. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, what do we do now...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hold the brush like this, dip it in the ink and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Write each character very carefully. Make sure to write straight lines decisively, like this... And curved lines with a bit of finesse, like this...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow! That looks awesome!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And I like the word you chose.
Challenge.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I chose it because I want to challenge myself to become as good at singing as everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But to do that, I have to gain experience by taking the initiative.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That makes sense. Nice!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If that's what Kohane is going with, I know what to pick.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Forward...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Now that I have the most awesome partner, and friends to match, all we have to do is to keep moving towards our goal.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I like your resolution too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, it's our turn now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sorry, Kohane. Can you show me again how to hold the brush?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure. Hold it like this and...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. They're really enjoying it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They really are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
How about you, Akito, Toya?
What are your New Year's resolutions?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Resolutions, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For me, it's... Determination.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Like sticking with it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. My dad disapproves, but I've made up my mind about singing with you guys.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I want to keep performing with you, no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Nice! That's great!
And what about you, Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess I don't have a choice...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Mine is... Victory. What happened at STAY GOLDEN is still nagging at me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:

There's so much I still need to tell you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Will we ever be able to come back?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This place isn't quite ready to become its own SEKAI yet.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So for now, this is goodbye...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Don't worry.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
This place won't be gone forever.
It's just going back to being a fragment of a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: At the very least, it'll remain in your hearts.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So someday...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When this sapling becomes a fully-grown tree, we might just be able to...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Please, give my other selves my regards.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: See you later, everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Where am I...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm back...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But... Where were we just now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I remember, but only vaguely...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait... I went somewhere just now...
I even talked to someone and really wanted to keep talking to them...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I felt happy... But sad too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For some reason, I really want to see Miku now.
Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I never thought I'd ever get to meet them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's okay, everyone, we'll see other again soon.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Our feelings will always be connected.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So when we do meet next time, let's all sing together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I'll be looking forward to singing something new.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Welcome, Miku.
Are you guys done with practice?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We found a good place to stop, so I came to help out.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I really appreciate that. And will it be a cafe au lait for you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, iced, please.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Coming right up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Practice went just fine but...
I can't help, but wonder...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (For a while now, it seems like An hasn't been at 100%.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But they did just perform in a big event. I suppose anyone would want to relax a little after something like that.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (At the same time, she seems bothered by something. So much so that Akito's begun to take notice.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is something bothering you, Miku? I hardly ever see you like this. Anyway, here's your cafe au lait.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Um, MEIKO...?
Have either An or Akito come to talk to you recently? Did they seem bothered by anything?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: An and Akito?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. An seems bothered by something and Akito seems to be worried about that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... I really can't say.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I didn't expect to hear that An's name when you first started talking.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was surprised too. I always figured that An would ask her teammates when she needed help figuring out something...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too. That was also exactly the case when she was trying to get Kohane to believe in herself more.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She tried talking to me, her father, Akito and Toya about it. Pretty much everybody she could.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right, and I think that's one of An's best qualities.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But something feels different this time around.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Could it simply be that it has nothing to do with us, music or her team...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm not sure...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I seem to only ever see that look of concern on her face whenever she's practicing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Akito probably became worried because it has everything to do with their music and team.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Not only that, she looks even worse whenever Kohane's name comes up in conversation.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What if it's something like this?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Like what?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's something she can't tell her teammates.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, don't kid with me. You know what I'm talking about, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She could be afraid of letting her teammates down or them not understanding her problems.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Everybody has their reasons.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, it could also be that she doesn't know how to talk about what she's feeling...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, how?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She might not quite know how to describe or explain whatever she's going through.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But the possibility that An wants to resolve this on her own isn't zero.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's still my expectation.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If you're that worried about her, why not just ask her yourself?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, I'd like to keep observing for a little while longer...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Like you said, there are still other possibilities out there and we don't know everything yet.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even Akito's still just watching and refraining from interjecting.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So for now, I should probably just be patient.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Since what one of them does affects the entire team, this may've just been an inevitability.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I really can't say what's bothering An, but I sure hope she finds a good way to get through this.)
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Phew...
That should be enough for today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting. I'm all done now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Busted, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, I can sense when you guys come over to SEKAI so...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Anyway, is something the matter?
I don't remember hearing anything about you guys having practice here today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, I just came here to talk. You know, about what's been bothering me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Shall we head over to MEIKO's place...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, here is fine.
Would you mind listening for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So, you know...
I really love the way Kohane sings.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My heart begins racing whenever she does and feel like something amazing's about to happen.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's why I want to be by her side...
I want to sing with her forever!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want to be a partner that she can respect and be proud of!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And this is how you truly feel, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It is, and I'm gonna do everything I can to make it happen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If that's the case, good for you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I had a feeling that she'd figure out what to do when An was singing with her, but...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to hear you make such a clear declaration. I may have to hold you to your word if you really mean it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I absolutely do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Good.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (An's finally going back to being her usual self.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, these growing pains are really rough.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Growing pains...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: From becoming someone's partner.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You can't really do much about that, can you? Especially since your partnership's still in its infancy.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Man, this is so hard...
Being way too protective at first was a huge mistake too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Again, I really doubt there was much you could've done about that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She finally found the right partner, but didn't do very well when it came to doing their first event.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'm sure she didn't want to lose Kohane so soon either. I can't blame her.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you think Akito and Toya had to go through anything like this...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Who knows? Why don't you ask them yourself?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But from what I've gathered, being someone's “partner” is different from being someone's friend or teammate.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which also means it's important to be honest with each other, like Akito and Toya.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sometimes you just have to have some tough conversations.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'm not saying that you should emulate everything they do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Akito and Toya, you and Kohane...
You're all different people with different personalities.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You need to be you, Kohane needs to be Kohane, and the Vivids need to be the Vivids...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Us being us...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. That goes for Vivid BAD SQUAD too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... I feel like being a “partner” just became that much more complicated.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I'm sure experience will be the best teacher there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, I'll just have to keep trying.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I understand why you want to beat yourself up...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you were able to take a hard look at yourself and what you were feeling, so I'm sure you'll figure out a way to be the best partner you can for Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. When you say it like that, Miku, it sounds like it's actually gonna happen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right?

rows.Speaker: An & Miku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for everything, Miku!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I might have to come back and ask you for help again...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's my job so you're welcome to at any time, especially if it's about your partner.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you guys will always have to make the final decision, which I know isn't easy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So feel free to ask me about everything else.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. You're way too cool!
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, Mafuyu.
Welcome.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What brings you here today...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We're supposed to check in with each other about our progress here today, so I decided to come early.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see.
Can we wait for the others to arrive together...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Mafuyu...
You met the girl who wrote those lyrics, yes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you feel anything then...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Not really.
We talked about songwriting, some other meaningless things and that was it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It snowed on our way home.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Snow?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Do you not know what snow is, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, I do.
The white and fluffy things that are cold and disappear when you touch them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I didn't know that it's gotten that cold in your world already, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It is, but... I guess it's hard to tell when seasons change when you're here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That evening, after I'd met the girl who wrote those lyrics, it snowed for the first time this year in our city.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, that's all that happened...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: By the way... Did you happen to feel something when you saw it snow, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You didn't actually tell me much about the girl who wrote those lyrics when I asked...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you spontaneously spoke about how it snowed on your way home, so I was wondering if that made you feel anything.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
Actually...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'd forgotten this entire time...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My mind's sole focus had become composing a song that's able to save many people.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But meeting Hoshino and Ms. Mochizuki today alongside being with you was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I feel this way because you gave me this opportunity to meet her, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Oh, my chest...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your chest felt warm...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You may be right, Miku. I think I did feel something...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But feeling warmth doesn't seem right. Snow is something that's cold and it was chilly outside.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My username in English even means “snow”, but I didn't really mean anything else by it. And yet...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, it's very strange.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Will I feel the same thing when I see snow...?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Um, Mafuyu...
I'd like to see some real snow.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sure... But I can't make it snow right now. Also, it doesn't snow much where we live.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's okay. I'll wait.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay...
But I wouldn't expect too much.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes.
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is it snowing, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I'm here to talk to Kanade in more detail about our song.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Miku...
I said this before, but it doesn't snow that often.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know, so I'll keep waiting.
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's not snowing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's not snowing, but...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The weather forecast said that it may snow the day after tomorrow, so I came here to let you know.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's really going to snow?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Probably. Well, as long as the forecast is correct.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The day after tomorrow. I'll be waiting.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...
Two days later
Mafuyu's Room

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Did you call, Mafuyu...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, welcome.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, is Miku here?
Hey, can you hear me?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Mizuki's voice... Are you all working right now?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. We're all here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Long time no see, Miku...
I guess you can't actually see me in this call, but how have you been?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm good.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Glad to hear that.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Is Kanade here too?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm here, Miku. I'm also glad that it snowed today.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Let me show you.
Just give me a second.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'll be on mute for a while.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sure, take your time.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, it might not snow again for a while, so you should enjoy it while you can.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I will. Thank you, everyone.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Can you see it, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, it's so white and fluffy...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So this is snow... Oh...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I can't actually touch it...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh... You are a hologram right now...
I'll try for you instead...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Here, this is snow...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It looks so white and fluffy in your hand... Oh...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It's gone...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, it turned into water.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Is snow cold?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A little.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Is it cold out...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I did open my window for this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(There's no way for me to tell...
I don't know what it's like outside or how cold Mafuyu feels...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And I was hoping to feel the same warmth that she did...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Do you want to see more snow...?
If so, here...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, you have more now...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
But it melts very quickly in my hands...
Here's some more...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Aren't your hands cold, Mafuyu?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
A little.
But this doesn't bother me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What Ena said about it snowing again in the future may be right, so here...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Mafuyu...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Oh... My chest...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It feels warm...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (This might not be what Mafuyu felt that time, but...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I felt it...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Thank you, Mafuyu. That should be enough.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm glad I was able to keep my promise...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Mafuyu...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm glad we got to see it snow.>
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That practice Karuta match we did was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I agree.
So much so that I'd like to do it every year.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Also, Miku, you were unbelievable!
Based on your speed alone, it's like you became a pro after playing just once last year!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe... Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But you did really well today, Len!
You got so many cards despite it being your first time playing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Very true. You seem to have a knack for figuring out how to play these sorts of games, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You think so?
To be fair, I'm still nowhere near Miku's level, so I'd like to try harder next time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hi, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Is everything okay, Rin?
You've had this cloud hanging over your head all day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
M-M-M-Miku...!
I'm tired of losing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Eep!
Wh-What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She lost to Len at Karuta today...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, is that why you've been feeling this way...? You really shouldn't beat yourself up like this since Len really does seem to have a talent for this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: He and KAITO even started playing chess for fun, but before we knew it, he'd racked up a huge winning streak...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
B-But...!
I played last time...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, Miku, I know what to do!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Y-Yes?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Please teach me how to play Karuta, Master!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: M-Master...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You can ask all you want, but I really wouldn't know where to start...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, in that case... Why are you able to get cards so fast? Can you explain that?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why I can get cards so fast...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, the poems for “Hyakunin Isshu” are all organized in a certain manner. An upper half to go along with a lower half.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So in theory, knowing which half goes with which should help increase the speed in which you get cards.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's why I went ahead and memorized them all!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A-All of them...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you're an idol... You really memorized every Hyakunin Isshu poem...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? I mean, I thought it'd be more fun and spectacular if I did everything I could to prepare for it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
M-Miku...!
Your aura's overwhelming...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But that explains everything...
No wonder I couldn't beat you!
I'll try memorizing them too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Great!
Once you've done that, we can start experimenting with how to get cards even faster.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Though a swift stream is divided by a boulder...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Think you know the other half, Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hold on... Wait...
“A swift stream”... That's...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No...!
I tried memorizing them, but I can't remember which is which...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
I don't blame you. The language they use is very archaic and cryptic...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're really good at memorizing lyrics, right, Rin? Why don't you try applying that method to Hyakunin Isshu?

rows.Speaker: Rin

rows.Line: Hmm... Maybe this fragment of a feeling is from someone who got tired of all of these?

rows.Line: Even fragments of feelings that didn't give birth to a SEKAI would even have the slightest bit of emotion...

rows.Line: For some reason, I can barely feel anything from any of these things here...

rows.Line: Now that I think about it, this fragment of a feeling was quite pale. Does that have anything to do with this?

rows.Line: I'm going to try to see if I can feel something...

rows.Line: (No matter how small or faint it may be, I know it's there somewhere...)

rows.Line: I think I felt it! Even if it was just a little bit!

rows.Line: (I bet this boy is a hard worker.)

rows.Line: I think I know what feelings the fragment originated from now.

rows.Line: (The feelings that created this SEKAI were definitely...)

rows.Line: I think I know what feelings the fragment originated from now.

rows.Line: (It's definitely...)

rows.Line: ...! The feeling got stronger for a second just now!

rows.Line: (Maybe it's because I realized what kind of emotion it was...)

rows.Line: I felt it again! I think it's coming from over there!

rows.Line: Oh, there's a wooden box buried in the ground. Could this be...

rows.Line: This is it! It's a little weak but I sense so many feelings coming from here.

rows.Line: But... Why is it coming from this box?

rows.Line: I'll just dig out enough soil to open the lid for now... Okay, here we go... Just a little more...

rows.Line: Huh? What happened to the lid? It's covered in nails. There's also chains wrapped around it and a padlock...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The feelings in this wooden box... Was it necessary to go this far to shut them away?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh... There're sheets of paper on the floor.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And this is...an answer sheet for a test.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is this...a novel?

rows.Line: But that's all that's on here. I guess the writer isn't finished...

rows.Line: (Everything I found in this SEKAI... The novel, the manga and even the music sheets. They're all unfinished.)

rows.Line: (On top of that, the unanswered form about post-graduation plans and the incomplete test answer sheet...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (All of these feelings from so many different people are shut in this box...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They were hidden...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Was it because they weren't wanted anymore? Or maybe, it got too overwhelming?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is that why they were locked up and hidden...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This SEKAI was born from...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The stress of choosing your own future, wasn't it...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Unsure of whether what you're doing now is the right thing, or whether it's even enough...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No matter how hard you try, there're times when you're uncertain or afraid...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's so hard to find a place that makes you feel needed or welcomes you to try in a way that works best for you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It takes so much courage to chase after your dreams, and there are only so many people who can help you achieve them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And naturally... You get anxious, and lost... And impatient...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It must've been so hard for you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So hard that you felt the need to lock those feelings up in this box and bury it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Was it because you didn't want anyone to know? Was it because you couldn't tell anyone about it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Or... Was it so painful that you couldn't take it anymore and had to give up?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't understand. Why would you shut a lid on these feelings like this...

rows.Line: I can only imagine just how unbearably difficult it must've been, but...it's such an important part of you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's a part of who you are...

rows.Line: All I want to do is to come find you, hold your hand and sing...

rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Line: ...! This SEKAI...

rows.Line: Wait! Please don't go!

rows.Line: I know you don't want to remember the pain and suffering, but...

rows.Line: So please... Don't erase them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO, you always seem to have a big smile on your face whenever we begin or end our meals.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I probably do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I mean, I can't help but smile when I see everyone looking forward to having what I make and really enjoying their food.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I see.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO, do you think I can do what you do?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What? You mean cook...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, there's that... But I'm also talking about making everyone smile. I want to give it a try.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh...? Yes, challenging yourself is always good, but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Based on how Miku cooks... She's going to need a lot of practice...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Um, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know. This is really sudden and you're not sure what to say.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, it's not that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've actually been thinking about this for a while now. I'd like to try helping everyone in other ways besides singing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, Kohane and the others have been trying to experience new things together, no?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're serious about this, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
...
Okay.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm prepared to help you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'm the one who wants to help everyone. Why does MEIKO need to prepare herself for that?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Or rather... She may be trying to empathize with me by seeing where I'm coming from...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, I'd like to start by trying to make that vegetable curry you served us the other day.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that?
Yes, it may be a good place to start.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (The curry powder's already mixed and the vegetables only need to be washed, peeled and chopped into halves or quarters.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (She should be fine as long as she's careful about how she peels them.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, Miku, shall we get started?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
First, we need to prep the vegetables.
We'll wash them and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Throw them all into the pot.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Oh dear. And here I was worried about her peeling them...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I put in the vegetables before filling it with water. I should probably do that first...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, you should, but I recommend you peel them since it'll make the curry have an overall better texture...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't some people include them whole? I remember hearing something about the skin being the most nutritious part...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The area just under the skin to be more precise. So, yes, there are some vegetables that don't need to be peeled...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, this dish mostly involves vegetables that do require peeling...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. Then, I'll use this knife to...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Let's use the peeler instead!
It'll be much easier!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? I forget how deep an onion's skin actually goes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, there's some tomatoes in the fridge. Can I use these?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If you wish to make tomato curry, be my guest...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I also heard that chocolate and cinnamon can work as a secret ingredient. I'll toss some in while I'm at it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh...? Wait, Miku! If you throw all of that in...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's already getting full. I must've put in more than I realized. Now, I need to add enough water to submerge them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Th-This should be plenty!
The water in the vegetables should more than make up for what's missing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, really? I didn't know that.
Thank you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha...
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It's starting to smell nice...
I think it's ready...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Alright, MEIKO...
Mind giving it a taste?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, it's good...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, it is! But how...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Are all of the ingredients she put in melding together and balancing each other out?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (What if Miku's actually some sort of genius when it comes to cooking...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Something smells nice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO!
Good timing! The curry is just about ready. Would you like some?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Are we having curry for lunch today?!
I'd love to have some!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, it just needs a little more stirring...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? My stirring seems to be causing something black to rise up from the bottom...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (What in the world...?! That color... I've got a bad feeling about this...!)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why don't we just serve what's on top?! I have a feeling that all the flavor is concentrated there!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, that can happen?
Then, okay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I feel like I've learned so much from you today, MEIKO. Thank you for doing this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Y-You're welcome...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Phew... KAITO narrowly escaped being served something awful...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (MEIKO ended up teaching me a lot of things in the end, but I think I'm starting to get the hang of cooking.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Hehe. Next time, I'd like to make some sweets from scratch for Kohane and the others.)
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
MEIKO, I'm here to use your kitchen.
Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But she promised to watch as I baked my cupcakes...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What? You want to bake some cupcakes?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Since KAITO was nice enough to teach us, I want to try baking some on my own.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I also want to give something back to Toya for causing him so much trouble and KAITO for teaching me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay.
You can use the kitchen whenever you like.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, everything I need to bake my cupcakes is all laid out. Does that mean she remembered...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If so, why isn't she here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, it must be because of what I said. She prepared everything for me, but is letting me bake them on my own...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, MEIKO. Message received.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I promise to bake some delicious cupcakes all by myself...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku! Have you already gotten started?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. You were delivering some food to Luka and Rin.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I apologize for running late as a result.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, that's okay. Anyway, shall we get started?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? Did you bring a notepad?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I tried remembering what KAITO taught us and wrote down as much as I could.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Based on this, I first need to...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Oh, she has all the steps correctly written down... Thank goodness. I didn't actually have the rush back the way I did...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (She said she's baking some for Toya and KAITO, so I'm guessing she wants to bake around five or six.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Then, two eggs should be more than enough...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, I'll start by cracking open ten eggs.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku, wait! Just how many cupcakes do you plan on making?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? Enough for you and me to taste, some to give to Toya and KAITO... So, maybe eight or ten?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. Then, three eggs should be plenty...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What? But my notepad says, “It'll make things easier later if you crack open all the eggs and remove the yolks first”...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That explains what you were about to do...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, that only has to do with separating the yolks from the whites. It says nothing about portions.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. Good catch...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Maybe I should stay and keep an eye on her...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay, they're ready.
I'll bring them over now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank goodness. They rose properly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, all ten seem to have risen evenly. And they're all a nice golden brown. They look delicious.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you, MEIKO...
I appreciate you helping me like this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, it was my pleasure.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
As proud as I am of her for using a notepad to cook...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (She interpreted certain things in such a strange way and even tried to throw in some extra twists... I couldn't take my eyes off her for a second...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Here's yours, MEIKO.
Let's see how they taste.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Ah, thank you.
Then...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Bon appetite...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
It's delicious!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank goodness.
They're nice and fluffy too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, they are. Which means, MEIKO...
I can give these to Toya and KAITO, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure they'll enjoy them very much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, Miku, while we're at it, how about we wrap them in something nice?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, good idea! Let's do that!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The girls are improving so much.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even just from the backing track they recorded, I can feel how strongly they want to make the solo show a success.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Shiho is especially on her game.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The way things are going, I'm sure they're on track for a great solo show.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But even then, I know they won't stop there.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They're going to keep perfecting their performance until the last second.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want to help them more.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay. I'll play it again from the start.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'll note down any comments or points for improvement and tell the girls later.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Oh... This part here.
Ichika said she felt like it lacked cohesion somehow.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Could it be that it's slightly off-beat? Or is the sound muddy?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's listen one more time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Honami's drum beat is steady.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(She's drumming with power and confidence...
And it feels as if she's adding her own personality to it.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Although, she could probably hit the kick drum with more strength for this part...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know! I'll ask MEIKO and Luka what they think.
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. It wouldn't hurt to hit the kick harder during that part.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, I think she could polish up the syncopated beat just before that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That way, she'll create a nice contrast when the kick comes in.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
Polish up...the syncopated...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, what are you doing?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm making notes of issues I've noticed or parts that could be even better.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That way, I'll remember them for the girls' next practice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And that should do it! Thanks, you two!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Luka
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'm glad I got their input. It makes sense that someone who plays an instrument regularly would spot things I wouldn't.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that sound... It's Rin and the others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh yeah. They might also have some insight on today's practice...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: While I'm here, I should go ask them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Phew...
I got so much good input from Rin and the others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They were saying that Saki is rushing ahead in places, and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, what? Where's that sheet of notes?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This sheet is MEIKO and Luka's advice... This one is KAITO's...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's weird. There should be one more...
Here you go.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...! That's it! How did it get...here...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You dropped it, so we came to give it back.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO! And Rin and Len, too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Silly Miku-P. It'd be such a waste to go losing your notes after working so hard on them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It really would. We were really shocked when we found them, you know.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: “We”? I was the one that found them. Well, that isn't important...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Anyway, we need to talk to you, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Talk to me?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. We were wondering whether we should all give advice to the girls together...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah♪ We want to help them pull off an amazing show just as much as you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. You don't need to put this all on yourself. We're with you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But, this is just something like a personal project of mine...
That's exactly what I'd call putting it all on yourself.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO! Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The two of us talked after you left, and we thought of many other pointers we wanted to share with the girls.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, could you include us too?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's no helping it. Well then, I guess we can all work on this together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, Len and KAITO! Let's share what we talked about just now♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have a pen and paper ready. Tell me everything.
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Uh... I think the calendar Saki brought is in this classroom.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh... There it is!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. The day of the solo show is circled over and over again in all different colors.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Come to think of it, didn't Saki and Rin start drawing flowers and animals to “brighten it up”?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But then...

rows.Speaker: Shiho & Len
rows.Line: Now no one can read it...

rows.Speaker: Saki & Rin
rows.Line: Teehee♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anyway, there are just a few days left until the show now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It being their first solo show is exciting enough, but it's also a big step toward their debut.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're working so hard every day. I hope it pays off...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No. There's no question about it for those four. I just know they're gonna kill it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. And after that, they really might be putting all their energy into debuting.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I wonder what it'll be like once they go pro.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe they'll do a debut show on a stage much bigger than at their usual live houses?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, and then their videos will get a huge number of views. And then they'll release CDs, and then...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello, everyone! We're Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks to all of your support, we're finally making our debut!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We hope this show conveys our gratitude for what it took to get us here and our passion for what lies ahead!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, here it is... Our debut song!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Look, Miku!
Our debut song already has two million views!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And the Miku cover of our original song that we posted early on is about to hit five million!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We have 100,000 followers on socials too! We're off to an amazing start♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's true. But this is just the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Let's keep sharing our music with the world!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Miku, I hope you'll keep watching over us for a long—
I mean, I hope you'll watch over us forever.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course. As long as SEKAI is around, I'll be there by your side.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Please bring us a CD of your debut song, if you could. We'll give it pride of place.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We should ask them to sign it too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good idea. That will be a good way to mark the—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. It will be our priceless treasure.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: L-Luka?! How long have you been there?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Just a minute or two. You looked like you were lost in some fun thoughts.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Uh... A-About that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka, please don't tell the others...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If they found out I was getting caught up in these fantasies before the solo show is even over...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you were doing that because you have confidence in their success, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Th-That's true, but... I was getting way ahead of myself, and that's not a good look for a senior...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, I'm asking you! Please keep this a secret!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I suppose I got to see you blush like that, so the least I can do in return is keep a secret.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Phew... I'm so glad it was just you who saw that...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, come to think of it... I think I saw Rin and Len outside the door when I came in.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?! S-So they might have seen me...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm kidding, Miku. Sorry.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What the...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka! Don't be so mean!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (There's so many shops and places in this Yokohama guidebook Minori left for us.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Let's see, Minori said that she and her group are going to...
Chinatown, was it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Check this out, Miku!
This steamed bun is shaped like a panda!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It is!
It's called a “panda bun”. That's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And this castella looks so soft and yummy!
I wonder what it tastes like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, then I'll get some for you as a souvenir!
We can all share!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope she and her group get to eat all of the things they want.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, there's stuff about the Red Brick Center on this page.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Haruka said that she and her group are going to go shopping there. I'm sure it'll be fun just looking around since there's so many shops.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What are you reading so intensely, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Luka! Rin!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was reading through the Yokohama guidebook. Minori, Haruka and their classes will be going there for a field trip♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! There's a huge red building and the sea!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This place is called the Red Brick Center.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well it definitely lives up to its name, given the red bricks. Looks historical too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Apparently it used to be a warehouse for the harbor. Here, it says so in the guidebook.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're right! So, it has three floors, huh? It looks really big and has lots of shops!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. Haruka said she wasn't even sure if they'll get to see everything.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's also Chinatown and the Ferris wheel too. Looks like there's a lot of fun places to go.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I didn't know that! Hey, where's Minori going?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She said Chinatown. Which page was it...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Isn't that where that magnificent gate is?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, it is. Oh, here's the page!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! That is magnificent! And huge too! There's a lot of people taking photos in front of it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. But it looks like the food vendors are the selling point of this place.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Here, look at where Minori put her sticky notes.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa, that's amazing! There's so many food places!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It seems like they stretch on and on once you go through the gate.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Authentic dim sum, broiled sweet chestnuts, castella... Everything looks so yummy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. Apparently even the steamed buns taste different depending on the shop, which makes you just want to try all of them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What's this? Sounds like someone is quite the glutton.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?! G-Give me a break. Airi said the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Rin & Luka
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I hope Minori and the others have lots of fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, me too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I told them to try to relax since they're always working so hard, but...)

rows.Line: (Haruka and Minori will be changing to the credit-based course.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Which means they won't get to be in the same class as their friends in the general education course...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (That's why I want them to enjoy the field trip with their friends as regular high school students.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, Miku. Wanna look and decide what places we would want to see if we were going?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That sounds like so much fun♪ Yeah, let's!

One, two, three, four!
