rows.Line: I guess it's because they're second-years now?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure that played a role, but don't you think it's mostly because they're signed to a label now?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It seems they're well underway preparing to make their debut.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I'm very excited for that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want everyone to hear them play their songs.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then they'll all fall in love with their music and—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, it's nothing.
Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I thought I'd find you here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Luka...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Sorry to interrupt your thoughts.
Something about the way you were acting earlier was weighing on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, what's bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's a little embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've been taking it for granted that the girls' music will be this widespread overnight success...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I'd be so happy if that happened...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But the reality is, actually being a professional has got to be even harder than becoming one, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I suppose so.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I realized that, if that's the case, I need to snap out of all my optimistic daydreams.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So I came here to cool off.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're always such a dependable senior, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm always trying my best to be one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder just how far the girls will go.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: How far do you want them to go?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What do you mean?
As far as they can, of course.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want them to soar into the distance like four shining shooting stars.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If they're taking off with that much force, we need to make sure we're not left behind.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hey, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's keep it up watching over our girls.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'll all keep watching over their path ahead, together.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four...
And two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Got to make sure to stretch my legs properly...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Done! Now, I guess I'll start with strength training.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Push-ups, sit-ups, some back exercises, then squats.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh! You're already starting back at school next week?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! And we'll be in the credit-based course at last! I'm getting a little excited.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I wonder what my classmates will be like?
I hope I'm put in Haruka's class...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, I'm going to be much more free to do idol work. Hehehe, I'm really looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (MORE MORE JUMP! are going to be more active than ever as idols...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I have to be on top of my game if I want to be in a position to support them.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright. Next up, sit-ups!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One... Two... Three... Four...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Phew...
That's three sets of everything.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now to—
Miku, do you have a moment?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sorry to interrupt your training.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The thing is, I accidentally made too much of this drink... I can't finish it all myself, so I came to give you some.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really? Well, if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't mind at all. It's still cold so I'm sure it'll be refreshing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You looked like you were really getting into your training just now, but maybe it'd be a good idea to take a break?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, were you waiting for me to finish, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Only for a little while.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was actually just going to leave the drink here so as not to disturb you, but—

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh no! Rehearsal's about to start! I need to get back to MEIKO and Rin ASAP!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh yeah, you're helping them prepare for their show, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. We're on the stage over there, so don't hesitate to come over if you need anything. See you later!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Got it! Thanks, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (He must have decided to call out to me since I wasn't stopping for a break.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When I train alone, I have a habit of getting too in-the-zone and forgetting to take breaks.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's try this drink then.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Ahh, that hits the spot!
So refreshing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have my own show with Luka and Len to prepare for. Once I'm done resting, I need to get a move on with training.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, there you are, Miku♪
You were practicing here, I see.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It's time for our group practice.
Are you finished with your solo training?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
I think it's going to take a little bit more time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll be done as soon as I can. Hold on!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, may I join you in that case?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Nice idea. I've been curious about your training routine, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But didn't you two just come from doing your own solo trainings? Aren't you tired?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Not at all♪
Unlike a certain someone, we don't forget to take breaks.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Also, we're going to make sure that you take regular breaks while we practice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay, I will.
I was actually just thinking about how I always forget to take breaks.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Are Luka and Len worried for me too?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It's thanks to everyone looking out for me like this that I'm able to do my best as an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It would be nice to pay them back somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'll think about what I can do after practice is over♪)
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (This should be the stage where MEIKO and Rin are putting on their show.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Oh, there they are!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And I'm in luck. KAITO's with them. They should be starting their rehearsal any—)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Oh, there they go...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Hehe, time to commence Operation Gratitude Repayment♪)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Their dancing is so lovely!
That choreography is adorable. Alright, I need to note these down...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Ooh... So close!
They were just a smidgen off-time. I'll write that down too...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Good work, MEIKO, Rin!
Let's take five.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Rin
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Here, take these drinks.
They're good for fatigue. Those towels just there are for you too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Aww, thank you♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe, KAITO.
I see that you have your own special drink today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Right here.
There's a sticky note that says “KAITO's Special Drink”.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? I didn't make that...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: KAITO, there's a notepad on top of the towels. Is it yours?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Whoa, it's full of notes about the song we just did.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You're right... But, this isn't mine.
I didn't have time to take notes while I was checking the sound and lighting...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, maybe...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I wonder if they noticed the notes and the drink. I hope it helps even just a little bit♪)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Now for Luka and Len!)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, over here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, you two♪
Let's do our best in today's practice.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's.
We found a few different areas for improvement last time, so we gotta work through them one by one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of that, I wrote them all out on this sheet of paper so it's easier to grasp.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ta-da♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wow...!
You've drawn up two whole tables for singing and dancing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I figured this would make it easier to get an overview of our problem areas.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, what are these squares next to each of the issues?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Those are spots to attach “Fantastic Job Flowers”.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Each issue we cross off will earn us a new flower until finally, the whole sheet is a field of blossoms!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, how lovely.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We'll need to work hard to make this sheet bloom, then.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku, are you around?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wait, KAITO?
And MEIKO and Rin too?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is your rehearsal over already?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, we still have more to go. But we wanted to say thank you first.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku, thank you for writing all those notes about where we were doing well and where we need to improve♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You figured out it was me...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe, we had a hunch.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you for my special drink too. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe... You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, look at that cute blush.
Do you mind explaining what happened?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: “Operation Gratitude Repayment”?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. Remember how I caused everyone to worry during my solo training the other day?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: After that, I wanted to show my gratitude by being helpful to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So the reason you made those tables was...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wanted to contribute what I could to make our show a success.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see. Thank you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd like to say thank you too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: My hands have been full during rehearsal, and I've been unable to focus on the singing and dancing, despite them being the main event. So, thank you so much for your detailed notes.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're gonna use them to make the rest of our rehearsal even better! Thanks so much!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, you're very welcome♪
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not here either...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I should've just waited patiently at the cafe. That said, there's no guarantee he would've stopped by.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm the one who wants to talk to him, so I should go look for him.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh... There he is! KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hiya, Miku.
Are you headed to practice?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, I've been looking for you.
I have a favor to ask.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wait, you want a favor from me?
It's not like you to seek me out like that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Don't tell me you actually have the utmost trust in me? Hahaha, you make me blush!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Alright, alright.
I want to discuss something, so settle down and hear me out.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd like you to put together several tracks.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't care if you use samples or anything, just make sure they're really hard to sing to.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What for?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For practice, of course.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kohane and the others are back on track to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They've overcome defeat and tears...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This very moment, they're putting in the effort to make their dream a reality.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So I want to bring my skill level up too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course, I won't ask you to do this for nothing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What? You're gonna give me something...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I thought long and hard and decided on what I thought would be the most sincere gift idea.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It must be something real special!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Man, I was gonna do it anyway without a reward or anything. But if you're gonna give me something, then I guess I'll accept it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It really is special, so you won't be disappointed.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wow, what is it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A batch of handmade cookies that go perfectly with coffee!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Whoa! Cookies?!
I'm stoked to try—

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hand...made...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup. I'm gonna put my sweat, blood and tears into them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
W-Wait, Miku!
I'm really happy you'll do that for me, but—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know, I know.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: My kitchen skills just aren't up to your standards. That's why...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm making you a sandwich and a cupcake to go with your cookies.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wait wait wait!
Why are you trying to make up for quality with quantity?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, even if I can only make something that's a three out of ten, three dishes will score a whole nine points.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hahaha...
Good one there, Miku.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But anyway, you've been getting better at cooking, so I don't think you'd actually score that low.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, you think so?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Even still, I'll pass on the reward this time. This is for Vivid BAD SQUAD after all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, but...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I also want them to do their best, and I genuinely want to help you improve for their sake.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not to mention that this is a good challenge for me if you think about it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A challenge?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Coming up with a track that even you find difficult to sing isn't gonna be a walk in the park.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, let's consider that challenge my reward.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'll put those tracks together for you.
You won't be disappointed!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Got it. Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Even KAITO has his cool moments.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I wonder how those tracks will turn out.
I can't wait.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Akito and the others haven't been dropping by lately.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah... And after practicing so much and learning to sing all those new songs too...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's because they're busy.
With practice.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's right.
Not to mention that they're second-years now and have a lot of changes to adjust to...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Bleh... But we're so bored.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you have time to sulk, maybe you have time to practice yourselves?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know...
We'll go do it once we finish our juice...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO. Thanks for the cafe au lait.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh... Where are you going, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just out for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Lately, Miku's been just casually disappearing as if she's KAITO or Luka or someone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Hey, MEIKO. Do you know what Miku's up to?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Up to?
She's just going to practice.

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You mean Miku's practicing singing?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Do you think Miku's the sort to call people out for not practicing but then slack off herself?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If you knew that then you shoulda said something!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Does this mean Miku's also gonna be all, “Hey, look how much I improved! Didn't I do a good job?” when Akito and the others come back?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If she does that, then our improvements won't be half as impressive!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Len, we gotta go practice now!
MEIKO, thanks for the juice!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No problem, and good luck.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(KAITO did a good job.
He really put together some hard songs.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (That last line needs to be bang on the rhythm. Otherwise, those sharp lyrics come off all limp.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I need to pay attention to where I put the accents too.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I want...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I want to be a better singer...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Kohane and the others will come up against so many more obstacles in the future.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And that's why they need someone who's got their back.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (If that's the case...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(I want to be that someone.
I want to be the wind in their sails.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (To do that, I need to be a better singer...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(The better a singer I become—
The more confident I become, the more persuasive I'll become.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And then, I'll say it to them with a smile.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'll say, “You'll be fine. You have what it takes.”)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I want those words to boost their confidence simply because they came from me.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Phew...
bgm_area00003

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have a basic grasp of it all now. All I need to do now is just keep singing it until it's second nature.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Voice
rows.Line:
Oh, there she is!
Everyone, over here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line: Miku! We came by to practice!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome back, everyone.
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
The sun's shining and smiling♪
And I'm feelin' super duper good♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
But I'd feel even happier if Tsukasa and the others came to visit...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But they're about to start a new “term”...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, and they're becoming “freelancers”!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're gonna spread their wings and soar faaar away from Phoenix Wonderland to study in lots of other places☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder what sorts of places they'll go to put on shows? Hehehe, I'm so excited for them♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Soar...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe! I just had an idea♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, listen!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, it's Miku!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What's got you so flustered?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. I have an idea.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What I thought was...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just like Tsukasa and everyone, we should all soar faaar away from SEKAI☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Soar away from SEKAI?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup! That way we can learn a lot more about shows☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That sounds very fun, Miku. But, I don't think it's possible...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Whaaat?! Even if we ride the flying train?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I doubt it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Aww... Really?
That's sad...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hey, don't give up that easily!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Do you have an idea?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I know what it is. We can do a show in our dreams...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, Luka... That's not it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We can “soar” away from this stage and do a show somewhere new!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If we do that, I'm confident we can have a change of pace by putting on a different type of show than normal♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's a good point.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everyone, would you be okay with trying to put on a different kind of show than normal since Miku came to us with her suggestion?

rows.Speaker: Luka, Rin & Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I would.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Y-You guys...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well then, I suppose the first thing to do is find a venue.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! Let's all look for a place where it would be fun to put on a show♪

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I bet it would be fun to do a show while riding the horsies on the merry-go-round♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh yes, it would.
It would be a very cute show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What about a show where the audience is looking down from the Ferris wheel?

rows.Speaker: Len

rows.Line: Oh, I can't tape this one up yet, so would you mind taking this one?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay... Wait, Shizuku, this box doesn't say what's inside or where it's supposed to go.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
I'm fairly certain it's full of things for our streaming room...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I already moved another box like that to the front door. Does that mean there are two?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Aren't you glad I asked before you taped it shut...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It's so interesting how everybody packs in different ways.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, I'm having fun just watching.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, Rin and the others should be done practicing soon. Why don't we go invite them to do the rounds with us, starting from Minori again?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We can go back for KAITO too♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Then, let's head back to SEKAI temporarily.
Shall we?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay♪>
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miku.
I feel much better now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too. Thank you for telling me about your battle with An and your recent training.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Still, I can't believe that you haven't been able to notch a single win. They must be really good.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They are... It's been a solid reminder of just how incredible the people who helped make RAD WEEKEND happen were.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Also, the thing is...
During our walk, I thought I should ask...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Miku...
Would you mind practicing with me right now?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right now...? Here?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, please...
I want to become better and stronger so that we can actually surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, let's practice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: While we're at it, let's play the same freestyling game you've been playing at your training.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you, Miku! I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She's got a chip on her shoulder now...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I guess her battle with An is the reason why.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She seemed to be her usual, cheerful self after it happened...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But I guess things aren't that simple.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She must be feeling so anxious, stuck and frustrated.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (After all, she's grown to become a better singer in that neighborhood by experiencing her fair share of victories and defeats...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (However, she's now trying to use that bitterness to become even stronger.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (To become an even better musician.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (That being said, I don't intend to lose...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, now it's my turn. Ready?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Phew.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You really are amazing, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Your power and technique are always good, but the way you sang just now...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's like you were trying to overwhelm me with your aura.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I thought a head-on battle would be what you need right now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Still... I lost again.
I have to find a way to win... To surpass them...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Sorry, Miku...
But can we try doing that again?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Kohane...
I understand how you feel, but you shouldn't push yourself so hard.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What matters most to you right now are the events you've been traveling to and your training at COL, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why don't we try singing together next?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. All this talk of winning and losing is going to just worsen your burden. So, why don't we just try singing freely?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'll start us off.
You jump in whenever you feel like it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, let's begin.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I thought that a head-on battle was the right choice just now, but I may've been mistaken...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Because I'm not the one Kohane has to surpass.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I should help her grow and become able to sing her heart out.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (You don't have to worry about winning against me. Just sing the way your heart tells you.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Because that's when you put on your best performances.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Now then...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I need to do my best to make up for showing off.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Kohane and the others are one step away from reaching the level of RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And I want to give them the push they need to get there.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (You can do it, Kohane.)
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry for making you guys wait!
We had to take care of something before coming over!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, there you all are.
Welcome.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We actually just finished setting everything up, so your timing couldn't have been better!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you all again for inviting us over today. Also, this is quite the sight to behold...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Every table's covered in different dishes...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, we are here to celebrate all of you putting on such an incredible event, are we not?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which is why we felt that we needed to respond in kind by throwing you the best after-party ever!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What she said!
So, we decided to make everything on the cafe's menu!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! Everything?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Also, we whipped up all of you guys' favorites!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! Look at all the sesame balls and peach buns...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Heehee♪ And we dished up some rum raisin ice cream just for you, An!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We have pancakes and cheesecake for you, Akito, and cookies for you, Toya♪ Feel free to have as many as you like!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I-Is it really okay for us to have such a feast...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Of course it is.
I mean, isn't now the best time to celebrate?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Miku wants you to try the dishes she made since she worked so hard on them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! You made some, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I did.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So... A-Are they okay to eat?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why wouldn't they be?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You sound pretty confident.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. There's nothing to worry about.
Miku put in a lot of hard work for this party.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, so we're gonna make all their favorites and everything else on the menu for their after-party!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They're gonna be so surprised when they see all the tables in this place covered in food!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, let's start deciding what we'll each be making. Beginning with...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, uhh... M-Miku, what if you concentrated on helping MEIKO?! You always work so well together...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Len.
I brought this with me today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A notebook... Full of recipes?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. The thing is, KAITO and Rin—

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's right! Rin and I asked MEIKO for her recipes and made it together!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: KAITO did all the writing and I drew the illustrations♪ Isn't it so much better to have everything summarized like this?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, I should be fine today as long as I keep this handy.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: To be honest, I'm still a bit worried...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Alright, I'll start by boiling some eggs.
Eleven minutes in the pot... Oh, it's that simple?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, I'll put them in the pot and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, wait. What if I microwaved them?
Wouldn't that be much faster?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
No, stop! Don't do that!
They'll explode if you do!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, ignoring what your notebook says would completely defeat the purpose of having it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Ah, good point.
Then, I'll put them in the pot and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
This soup needs two teaspoons of salt.
Okay, here's my teaspoon and...about this much salt?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, you piled that way too high!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We'll measure everything out while you focus on stirring the pot.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Right...
Not having to do all the little things would help simplify this process.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
So, leave the stirring to me.
I want everyone to really enjoy what I make.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I was genuinely moved by your event.
And this is my way of expressing what I felt.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, please have as much food as you like today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: From the bottom of my heart, congratulations.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Miku...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But we were only able to put on that event because of you and the others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Whenever we couldn't sing the way we wanted or those times we didn't understand what we were feeling, you were there for us...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We were able to keep moving forward because we had you helping us every step of the way.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, we can't thank all of you enough!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We actually prepared a little present for all of you to show you our gratitude!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! A present?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We had a feeling that you'd want to throw a party for us, so we decided to come up with a little surprise in return.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That being said, we weren't expecting to see such a decadent feast.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, ta-daaa!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We made a bunch of little cakes.
We even decorated them with fruits that match your personalities!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: For example, Miku, we used muscat grapes for yours as a reflection of the refreshing green of your eyes and hair.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't think any of us were expecting you all to prepare a surprise for us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you.
This makes us really happy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Anyway, shall we get started?
Everyone have their drinks ready?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Cheeers!
Cheers!
Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We got to experience everybody's feelings firsthand, see how each SEKAI evolved and so much more...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Which SEKAI did you see when you touched your fragment, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I saw...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Who are you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm Miku.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Miku, as in...Hatsune Miku?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'm so tired...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I've looked and looked, but still haven't found any answers...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I see...
You saw Mafuyu's SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I did...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That SEKAI is sort of rooted in pain, anguish and sadness...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, and it's not just her...
Those around her also face those struggles.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Because at one point or another, they each felt like disappearing completely.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, one still does...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I also became incredibly worried about Mafuyu when I first learned about that SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She's no longer alone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even if they came together because of the fact that they all wished to disappear...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not being alone means having someone there to hear your pain. To understand, to empathize, to support.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll keep composing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If no one acknowledges or recognizes you now, just keep drawing until someone does.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We have to keep creating what we do anyway so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't want to see you with that awful look on your face, and I want to help you in whatever way I can...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So please, tell me when you feel you're ready. I'll be waiting until then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: When you think you've reached your limit, I say run. Get out while you can.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: For your own sake, Mafuyu. You. No one else.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, you're working so hard for the sake of others...! You deserve to be happy too!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<So, Kanade...
I think you should also do what makes you the happiest.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everything they're carrying is both deep and heavy...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I worry each time they try to face the truth because it can be so painful for them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But they've been able to move forward little by little because they've been so brave.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe.
No one will wipe away your tears for you if you're all by yourself.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And smile with you when something fun happens!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In that regard, meeting the right people is so important.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. Those four were brought together by Kanade's music like it was fated to happen.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And the feeling that they shared in common allowed them to forge a powerful bond.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It had to be those three. Otherwise, Mafuyu wouldn't have been able to move forward and that SEKAI wouldn't have undergone such a dramatic change.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Things likely won't be easy for the us in that SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I hope they all get to build the future that they're imagining, even if gradually.
Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which SEKAI should I take a look at today...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have to say that one again...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kanade and the others still aren't here...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mizuki stopped by a second ago to see how many forks and paper plates we had left.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But we're all out, so they have to go buy more...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Umm...
Where are MEIKO and KAITO...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I already told MEIKO that they'll be bringing a cake over...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I told KAITO...
But he just ignored me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If they don't want to come, then that's their loss. It means we get to have their slices.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It sounds like they're going to have some cake with Kanade and the others. Are they waiting for them to arrive right now...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The MEIKO and KAITO in that SEKAI really do seem to prefer being alone...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'm so glad that the me of that SEKAI isn't all by herself anymore.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Since she really was alone when it first appeared.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Back then, she spent most of her time just sitting and staring off into space...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She looked happy whenever Mafuyu came to visit, but it usually meant Mafuyu was in pain.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So that SEKAI's me was probably feeling a complex mix of emotions.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She was caught in a pickle. She wanted Mafuyu to visit, but didn't at the same time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, Kanade and the others came over...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin arrived next, because of a shift in that SEKAI's feelings...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Followed by MEIKO and Luka...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. That reminds me of the time the four of them played cat's cradle together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They seemed to have so much fun that I wished I could play with them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I still see them playing cat's cradle from time to time. I have to think that it's become one of their favorite games.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, then Len arrived...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Our Len was so surprised by how different they were from each other.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: On the other hand, Rin thought that SEKAI's version of him was kind of cute.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Still, I don't think any of us were expecting KAITO to surprise us more than when Len arrived...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was honestly a little afraid of him initially...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But Mafuyu took a hard look at her own needs because of him.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Overall, I'm glad that they're all there now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, the feelings and emotions that Mafuyu and the others are carrying are too much for SEKAI me to handle all on her own...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All I can do is watch over them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I hope that someday, the feelings of our SEKAI selves will connect with theirs and bring about something beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, look...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The cake's here...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...? Is someone singing...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But who...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But it feels warm for some reason...
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Seems like everyone's here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Without further ado! Let us commence the Miku's Anniversary Special Excursion meeting!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Miku, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Isn't this great, Miku? You've been wanting to go on an excursion for so long.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What? You want to go on an excursion for your anniversary, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not do a show?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wanna buy snacks with just my allowance, and spend the whole trip home talking about how much fun we had♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup, yup♪ Buying snacks and getting ready is also part of the fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I get that, but so far... We've only talked about the prep work before, and the way home after.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're right! What happened to the activities?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's alright.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you'd like to leave it up to us, then we'll think of activities that you'd enjoy, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?! Then, let's do that♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've been so excited for the excursion all of you planned☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I guarantee that it'll be interesting and fun.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Before we depart, I'll be checking everyone's stuff☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Does everyone have the itinerary Emu and Nene made?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Do you have all of your snacks?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah♪ I have the snacks I bought with you. I made sure not to eat them before today, too☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, excellent!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That backpack looks like it'd make a great pillow. What's inside?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I have stuff for our activities in here. Although, we'll only get to use them after we arrive at our location...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh yeah, it says that we have three activities on the itinerary. That means we get to play three times♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it also says we'll be doing the first activity while we're walking.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. That's because our first activity is singing while we walk together♪

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Singing?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, now that we're done checking, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! Let's set forth!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nene, let's sing together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Sure.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh! You look like you're having so much fun♪ Can we join too?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa! Tsukasa! Can I have my snacks now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course! We have arrived at our destination, after all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, let's start the second activity while we're having our snacks.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our next activity will be... “What's in the box?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As the name suggests, you need to figure out what's in the box only from touch! But don't worry, I've already made sure that it won't include anything strange.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Well, that is if you assume it is an ordinary dog plushie. However...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They have no idea it's a dog plushie from SEKAI that agreed to be a part of my plan. Hehehe...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yikes. He's totally planning something...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The last activity will be... “Team Badminton Rallies♪”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Split into Team Miku and Team Tsukasa, and hit the shuttle as many times as you can in three minutes!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Each team only has two rackets. As soon as you hit the shuttle, make sure to pass the racket to another team member.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. It's not enough just to juggle the shuttle, you need to remember to pass the racket as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That sounds like so much fun♪
Let's do our best, Team☆

rows.Speaker: Emu, Rui, Len & MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're back!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe☆ Look at that, everyone is all smiles and sunshine!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I suppose our excursion has finally come to an end.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene, Rui! Thank you for putting this excursion together!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I had so, so, sooo much fun☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! I'm so glad!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And thank you for coming on this excursion with me, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You are most welcome. But, it's still a little early to thank us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's right! Now it's time for your anniversary party!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, KAITO, let us bring out the tables and chairs!

rows.Line: Practicing my singing seems unrelated to finding my friends, but is there some connection?

rows.Line: If I'm right, then the power of your feelings affected the sleep-learning machine and allowed you to come here.

rows.Line: And if your friends had similar feelings in their hearts when they used their sleep-learning machines...

rows.Line: I see...

rows.Line: In which case, if I sing with feeling too, that will reach them... And it may just lead them to me!
